newsitem.title: UK: Czarnikow cuts India 1996/97 sugar output forecast.
newsitem.headline: Czarnikow cuts India 1996/97 sugar output forecast.

text.p: Czarnikow Sugar cut its estimate for India's 1996/97 sugar production to 14.24 million tonnes raw value, 760,000 tonnes lower than the previous February forecast, a report showed on Thursday.

Czarnikow said it was not surprising that growers had turned to alternative crops, leading to a fall in cane availability as beginning stocks stood close to 8.0 million tonnes and cane arrears were above $200 million.
India produced a bumper 17.88 million tonnes of sugar in 1995/96.
But the lower production forecast could lead to problems with India's ending sugar stocks, which were still higher than a year ago, Czarnikow said.
There was already some concern that the portion of stocks allocated as levy stocks was quite low.

"Both the government and industry are aware of the prospect of an even lower crop next season but although the large reserves of stock can cover a deficit from quite a low 97/98 crop, there will be various problems if pre-emptive action is not taken soon," it said.
The first need was to reverse the production trend before the third poor crop developed in 1998/99.
But if the 1997/98 crop fell to 11 million tonnes white value, as expected, the levy stock could technically move into deficit.
Exports would be unlikely to reduce the huge stock as world prices were below those inside India.
Much of this season's shipments would be cross-border deliveries to Pakistan and would probably be less than 400,000 tonnes.
Czarnikow said India's production/consumption deficit would be the factor which would reduce the stock figure.
With consumption at almost 14 million tonnes white value, carry-over levels were likely to have fallen to 6.6 million by the end of September.

But it said the differential would probably widen further to some 3.5 million next season, which if stocks were cut by this amount, would bring them below adequate carry-over levels at the start of the 1998/99 season.
